text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Spring). Since Tamamo 
Cross was running, I came with Oguri Cap 
to scout, but...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—She broke through! Tamamo Cross breaks 
away! Tamamo Cross takes the lead! Tamamo 
Cross is in front!

Tamamo Cross burst out from the pack. 
Before anyone realized it, she blew past 
the other Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross strikes like a bolt of 
lightning! She takes first place with 
ease!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is Tama really that fast? Is she really 
that strong?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to race against Tama!
Then there's only one race to run next!

—Before the Arima Kinen, Oguri Cap's next 
goal was decided!
